summary: Phase 2 testing of EarnPlay — Tap Challenge, Missions, Global Chat, real Weekly/Monthly leaderboard windows, and 5-tab navigation. Backend: 19/19 new pytest cases pass (40/40 cumulative with Phase 1). Frontend: All Phase 2 critical flows verified end-to-end via mobile viewport (390x844): login, 5-tab bottom nav, Home quick-actions (incl. action-tap & action-missions), Games tab (4 LIVE cards + missions banner), Missions screen (4 mission cards render), Tap Challenge (start → tap → result → again/done), Chat (send appears in list immediately + via poll), Leaderboard period switching weekly/monthly/all.

react_native_issues.issue: Persistent (non-blocking) bundler warnings: 'shadow*' deprecated → use boxShadow; props.pointerEvents deprecated; Image style.resizeMode deprecated; Animated useNativeDriver fallback in web preview. None affect functionality.

action_items: Phase 2 is solid — no required fixes from this iteration.
Optional: pin bcrypt<4 or upgrade passlib to silence the passlib bcrypt __about__ traceback in backend logs (cosmetic).
Optional polish: address deprecated style props (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, Image.style.resizeMode) to clean up console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Leaderboard list intentionally renders rank 4+ via data.slice(3); ranks 1–3 live in the podium (no leaderboard-row-* testID). When window data has ≤3 entries, the FlatList body is empty by design — NOT a bug. Tests should look at podium when entries are few.
Mission 'tap_100' uses set_value (max-of) semantics — correctly never decreases progress, and the response GET /api/missions caps progress at goal via min(progress, goal). Good.
Anti-cheat clamp on tap (max ~12 taps/sec) verified: 1000 taps in 1000ms clamps to 17. Safe.
Chat empty text returns 422 (Pydantic min_length=1) and missing-token returns 401 — both per spec.

Spin still rate-limits at 1/min per user (verified by Phase 1 tests still green); mission spin_2 needs 2 spins separated by ≥60s OR two different users to claim — surfaced as known constraint, not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase 2 critical flows (5-tab nav, quick-actions, games cards, missions banner+screen, tap challenge full loop, chat send/poll, leaderboard period switching)

seed_data_creation: Created two TEST_p2_<hex>@earnplay.app users plus chat messages prefixed 'TEST hi <hex>' and 'TEST hello <hex>'. They will appear in weekly/monthly leaderboards for ~7/30 days. Safe to delete by email prefix TEST_p2_ or username prefix TESTp2_ if cleanup is desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run all backend tests with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Phase 1 file: backend_test.py (21 tests). Phase 2 file: test_phase2.py (19 tests). Frontend tabs are addressable via testID tab-button-{index|games|chat|leaderboard|profile}. Leaderboard period tabs use testID tab-{weekly|monthly|all}. IMPORTANT: leaderboard-row-N testIDs only exist for ranks ≥4 because ranks 1-3 render in the podium component — when total entries ≤3, querying leaderboard-row-* returns 0 (this is expected, not a bug; assert podium content instead). Spin rate-limit (1/min) means missions spin_2 needs two registered users or a 60s wait between spins to test claim path. Chat polls every 4s; optimistic local append also works so test can verify immediately.
rca_of_issue: No new issues encountered in this iteration. Phase 1 fixes (tz-aware spin datetime + expo-router useFocusEffect) remain stable. All Phase 2 endpoints (tap/submit, missions list+claim, chat get/post, leaderboard weekly/monthly aggregating xp_events) work to spec.
